# Machine Learning for Tabular Data: Baselines and Validation

> Take a tabular prediction from the decision it serves to a model card: a logged baseline ladder, validation that mirrors use, a leakage audit, a threshold that fits capacity and errors by subgroup with intervals. SDAIA Academy course DS-204, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 24,805 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Frame and baseline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day1.md): From the advisers' question to a number every later model has to beat; sessions: A prediction serves a decision, The baseline ladder, Linear models first, Features from history; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day1.html; about 6,204 tokens
- [Day 2: Trees and challengers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day2.md): Boosted trees, a fixed tuning budget, an automated challenger and a paired decision; sessions: Gradient-boosted trees, Tuning under a budget, Automated and pretrained challengers, Is the challenger better; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day2.html; about 5,529 tokens
- [Day 3: Validation and leakage](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day3.md): The split that mirrors use, the four kinds of leakage and how to audit a score; sessions: The split decides the score, Kinds of leakage, Hunting planted leaks, Reading someone else's notebook; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day3.html; about 5,735 tokens
- [Day 4: Errors, groups and documentation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day4.md): Where to cut the ranking, whether its probabilities hold, for whom it fails, and what to write down; sessions: Thresholds for rare outcomes, Calibration, Errors by subgroup, The model card; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/day4.html; about 5,641 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a validated tabular model and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/capstone.md): Each participant defends a tabular model from framing to model card in eight minutes, including one change the assessor asks for; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/slides/capstone.html; about 1,274 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Frame the non-completion question](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D1_1_frame.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: A constant and three rules](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D1_2_baselines.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A logistic model in a pipeline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D1_3_logistic_pipeline.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Two history features](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D1_4_history_features.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Boosted trees with defaults](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D2_1_boosted_defaults.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Twenty trials in nested folds](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D2_2_nested_search.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: A challenger on equal terms](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D2_3_challenger.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: The paired difference and the decision](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D2_4_paired_difference.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: One model, three splits](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D3_1_three_splits.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Six leaks from other projects](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D3_2_six_leaks.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Four planted leaks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D3_3_leak_hunt.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A colleague's notebook](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D3_4_colleague_notebook.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: A threshold that fits capacity](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D4_1_threshold_capacity.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Calibrate and compare by decile](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D4_2_calibration.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Errors by region, gender and age band](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D4_3_subgroup_errors.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: The model card and the capstone problem](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-204/labs/D4_4_model_card.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
